main_text.p: קל, קלל קל Leve, קל וחומר vide חמר . Geminatâ primâ litera, קלקל קלקלה Vastare, Corrumpere, Deftruere. קלקול Vastatio, Perditio: Item, Despectio, Vilipensio. קליל Leve, Modicum, parum. בנקל, נקל Levisimè, Facillimè: קלות ראש Erectio capitis levis, levitatem & superbiam denotans. בקלות Leviter, facilè.
קולמוס, קלם Calamus scriptorius: Plural. קולמוסין Ca-lami. קלמר Calamarium.
קלס Laudare. קלום Laudatio, Laus: קלסתר Effigies: Forma, R. David, 2.Sam.2.3.
קלף Decorticare. קליפה Decorticatio, Cortex: קליפת ביצה Putamen ovi. קלף Membrana, Fergamenum. Item Charta, Folia lusoria.
קלוש קלש Tenue: טיט קלוש Lutum tenue.
קם Ante. קמוהי Ante eum. קמא Primum, Anterius, apud Talmudicos. Contractum ex קדם vel קדם. Item לקפן Mox, Infrà, Paulò post, quasi Ante nos. Oppositum ejus, לעיל Supra.
קמע, קמיע קמיע Amuletum, Charta experimentalis de collo suspensa: קמיעא Idem. קמעא Parum, modicum.
קמץ Colligere in pugillum. קמצן Parcus, Tenax. קמיצה Digitus annularis, minimo proximus. קמוץ Kamczatum, cum Kametz notatum. נקמץ Idem, ex Niphal.
קנא, קנאן Zelotypus, Zelotes: קנאית Zelotypa mulier.
קונדיטון Conditum vinum, Confectus potus ex aromatibus, melle & aliis, Eccles.2.1. in R.Sal.
קנר Acquirere, Possidere. קנין Acquisitum, Possessio: Habitus acquisitus: Oppositum ejus העדר Privatio.
קנט, קנט הקניט Irritavit. קנטר Vexare, Irridere. קנטורין

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied as far as legible at this scan resolution; several pointed Hebrew forms in the headwords are uncertain and not marked individually, so check them against a higher-resolution image. "Fergamenum" is printed as shown (likely error for Pergamenum). "Kamczatum" is printed as shown. The printed hyphen in "Ca-lami" is kept. The catchword "Vexatio-" is at the foot and is not repeated in the text.
